n: <int> Total number of nodes (customers) in the network.
p: <int> Number of nodes to be selected as facility sites (medians).
node_coordinates: <list[list[int]], shape [n][2]> Two-dimensional integer coordinates for each node.
cost_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [n][n]> Pairwise service cost between every pair of nodes, where the cost from a node to itself is zero.
